body.statement: If \(\mathcal M\subseteq\mathcal E_3\), then for every \(t\in\mathcal B\), \(p_t=p^\star\), \(m_t=p^\star\mu_t^\star\), and \(\mu_t^\star=m_t/p_t\). Therefore every nonempty perfect-complier factorial effect is identified by \(\theta_S=2^{-2}\sum_{t\in\mathcal B}\chi_S(t)m_t/p_t\).
body.justification: The formulas translate the behavioral envelope into estimands computable from randomized assignment cells.
body.gap: The signed ratios coincide algebraically with existing perfect-complier formulas under separable receipt; the new claim is their validity on the strictly larger classified envelope.
body.consumer: The result directly supplies all seven main and interaction effects required by a three-factor perfect-complier analysis.
